name: nexus
description: NEXUS CRM and workflow management platform foundation

scripts.build: npm run generate --workspace @nexus/database && npm run build --workspace @nexus/database && npm run build --workspace @nexus/api && npm run build --workspace @nexus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @nexus/database && npm run build --workspace @nexus/database && npm run typecheck --workspace @nexus/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @nexus/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @nexus/api && npm run lint --workspace @nexus/web
